name: cash.statements.intraday

list.description: Read intraday statements for explicit account, currency and date scope.

parameters.name: inst-id
parameters.description: Institution identifier; Z21 is the qualified reference scope.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Explicit account alias sent as one native array member.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Inclusive value date start, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive value date end, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: fund-direction
parameters.description: Exact native fundDirection match; repeated values select their union locally.

purpose: Inspect scoped intraday bank movements, exact amounts and native fund directions.

fields.name: end2EndId
fields.meaning: Native intraday statement primary key; exact value and type retained.

fields.name: valueDate
fields.meaning: Source value date; distinct from transaction date and capture time.

fields.name: bankTransNo
fields.meaning: Native bank transaction number retained as output; not the statement identity.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Unscaled native amount; null, empty text and zero are distinct.

fields.name: fundDirection
fields.meaning: Source fund direction; never inferred from the amount sign.

identity_description: Native end2EndId primary key, retaining its source value and type. Account/currency/date scope is checked independently; repeated bank transaction numbers do not merge distinct statements.
limitations: Fixed tenant GUAPW3SG, POST /bankAccountDetailQuery.json, rowStart offsets and pageSize=1000; timezone GMT+08.
Explicit account alias, currency and inclusive date bounds are required for acquisition. Z21 is the default institution; no scope inference from alias.
Native amounts, dates, timezones and unknown fields retain their values and types. Capture time does not replace transaction or value date.
Total is data.totalCount and must remain fixed; duplicate native statement identities and contradictory scope fail.
fund-direction is a local exact filter. Refresh saves the entire acquired scope; cached replay needs no acquisition parameters.

examples.title: Read scoped native intraday statements
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list cash.statements.intraday --live --account-alias ACCOUNT_ALIAS --currency USD --from-date 2026-10-01 --to-date 2026-10-01 --limit 0
